answers.answer: AcceptWithScope. Retain all six intents: FromInteger(BigInteger), its schema-name overload, BigIntegerValue, FromDecimal(XdmExactDecimal), its schema-name overload and ExactDecimalValue. Accept required caller-supplied positive finite snapshot/cache/atom/digit counts, nonnegative scale, invalid default SchemaQueryLimits, explicit supplied coefficient-digit/scale capacities before normalization, and explicit formatting capacity. No implicit query/numeric workload defaults or unlimited fallback. Optional assessment diagnostic tightening with finite provider diagnostic defaults is a separate bounded policy, not a query/numeric default. Exact decimals normalize coefficient/scale and zero; ToInvariantString is not an XSD canonical serializer. Preserve wrong-kind checks: BigIntegerValue accepts integer kind and only recognized decimal-backed integer representations, not ordinary decimal; ExactDecimalValue accepts decimal kind and the specified integer-tagged decimal representation, refusing Kind.Integer. Narrowing refuses overflow/inexactness, never rounds; annotation strings confer no authority. Enforce bounds in admission/parsing/arithmetic/casts/map-key hashing/comparison/serialization before large allocations where possible; an existing caller BigInteger is not retroactively bounded. Enforcement is R3, measured workload ceilings R4. No R2 finite-policy blocker or additional required signature remains.

Bytes can expose backing arrays and OutputProperties is mutable: consumers must copy bytes and snapshot permitted property values before retention/thread handoff/export; no deep immutability guarantee. R03: Accept separate admission/work/ordered cleanup diagnostics, capture retained through cleanup failure, unsuccessful Partial/Cancelled/error outcomes, identity deduplication and preserved provider aggregate boundaries. Rollback stays AdmissionError; cleanup uncertainty is not release success and does not justify automatic retry. R04: Invocation is sole template/mode/base-output source; duplicate options fields must be absent and RawResult refuses. Four count/byte controls are finite/nonnegative, time/operation controls finite/positive. MaxMessages bounds count, not individual message bytes; output limits do not bound compiler/tree/native allocation, single-evaluation work or worker stacks. This bounded in-process Schema design does not require an extra Core message-byte limit. Arbitrary/untrusted IPC preview or hard total-memory/deadline guarantees are outside scope and require separately qualified host policy. No workload defaults/budgets are accepted. Borrowed engine gates compose only in an explicitly sequential profile; unsupported arbitrary caller policies refuse. R05: Foreign/closed operations and source roles reject before getters. R07: Core measurements are observations, not Schema budgets/defaults or worker/native/recovery qualification; R3/R4 must qualify the chosen execution profile. originalExceptionGraphDisposition: Exception, Data and InnerException graphs are local diagnostic references only, not immutable/detached schema evidence and not safe for IPC. Preserve object identity and aggregate boundaries for local diagnosis; do not recursively inspect provider objects, treat exception payloads as schema facts, or traverse nodes after admission revocation. Do not serialize or publish raw exception graphs. Any external diagnostic projection requires a separate owner-controlled bounded allowlist/redaction policy. Exception retention does not establish typed-value validity, authority, compatibility or successful cleanup.
